us-bibliographic-data-grant.invention-title: Laptop stand with a locking hinge

abstract.p: A laptop stand has a base, a support plate and a hinge between them. A locking pin of the hinge engages one of a row of holes, which holds the support plate at one of five angles.

description.heading: BACKGROUND
description.p: Laptop stands with a friction hinge lose their angle under the load of typing.
description.heading: SUMMARY
description.p: The stand holds its angle with a locking pin instead of friction.

The base is made of aluminium, and the support plate of a glass-filled polymer.

claim.claim-text: 1. A laptop stand comprising: a base; a support plate; and a hinge between the base and the support plate, the hinge having a locking pin that engages one of a row of holes.
2. The laptop stand of claim 1, wherein the row of holes has five holes.
3. The laptop stand of claim 1, wherein the base is made of aluminium.
